name: Pálháza (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the town arms of Pálháza (a white and green shield with a red cross, a stag and a tree, within a green wreath) above a yellow scroll inscribed PÁLHÁZA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pálháza arms with wreath and scroll
